name: Levelr
tagline: Bubble level, angle, ruler, sound meter and compass in one app.
description: Levelr turns your phone into a measuring toolbox. Check a surface with the bubble level, read an angle with the inclinometer, measure with an on-screen ruler drawn at true scale, estimate loudness with the sound meter, and find your heading with the compass. Everything runs on your phone, with no ads and no tracking.
